summary: Avino Silver & Gold Mines Ltd filed a Form 6-K containing its interim financial statements for the first quarter ended March 31, 2026. The filing is a routine quarterly report under Canadian securities regulations, furnished to the SEC under the multi-jurisdictional disclosure system. It includes condensed consolidated financial statements prepared under IFRS, notes on share capital, stock options, restricted share units, and risk management disclosures. There is no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, spin-off, restructuring, or management change described. This is a standard periodic disclosure with no corporate action requiring classification.
